---
title: "Recent News and Updates"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
```

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Create dropdown menu
dropdown_menu <- function(news) {
  cat('<div class="dropdown">\n')
  cat('<button class="btn btn-primary dropdown-toggle" type="button" id="dropdownMenuButton" data-toggle="dropdown" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">Recent News</button>\n')
  cat('<div class="dropdown-menu" aria-labelledby="dropdownMenuButton">\n')
  for (item in news) {
    cat(paste0('<a class="dropdown-item" href="#">', html_escape(item$title), '</a>\n'))
  }
  cat('</div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n')
}

# Render the dropdown menu
dropdown_menu(news_updates)
```

## Detailed Updates

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Display detailed news updates
for (item in news_updates) {
  cat(paste0("### ", item$title, "\n\n"))
  cat(paste0("**Date:** ", item$date, "\n\n"))
  cat(paste0(item$content, "\n\n"))
  if (!is.null(item$details)) {
    cat("<ul>\n")
    for (detail in item$details) {
      cat(paste0("<li>", html_escape(detail), "</li>\n"))
    }
    cat("</ul>\n\n")
  }
}
```
